description:
## Goal

Make `RuntimeDemand(E)` an ordinary change-driven fact formula and delete the whole-cone product calculation. A newly discovered callable edge becomes one exact dependency and contribution; it never causes standing values to reset and replay from bottom.

This is the main proven cold-compilation hotspot and the central spreadsheet-model repair after product state survives across requests.

## Current signal at a3a9761d1

On `00420_enum_take_drop_split`, one cold debug-interp request produced eight demand-cone settlements: two one-member cones, four 198-member cones, and two 204-member cones. The large cones each climbed 17 rounds and ran 1,028 or 1,068 member derivations; `external_members` was zero throughout. A debug sampling profile placed roughly one quarter of captured main-thread stacks within runtime-demand production.

`produce_runtime_demand_product` collects a transitive cone, settles every member from bottom, discovers actual callable-flow edges from the result, and may discard and repeat the calculation. One product key therefore hides a program-scale unit of work.

## Correct model

Runtime demand is a monotone calculation over per-executable demand values and source-owned target contributions:

- `RuntimeDemand(E)` has one FactKey, one authoritative World slot, and one producer formula.
- A formula reads Current peer demand or contribution facts, including recorded absence; it never waits on a cyclic peer.
- Each caller owns replaceable contributions to exact target cells. Retraction removes only that caller contribution.
- Cyclic convergence comes from ordinary change-driven wakes and transitive settledness.
- Artifact and transport consumers wait on settled demand facts.
- A dormant persistent root session receives the resulting fact movements through its exact subscriptions.

Preserve `ExecutableRuntimeDemand` as one semantic projection initially unless causal evidence proves that independently moving fields cause false wakes. Do not split cells speculatively.

## Prerequisites

- `fz-kdt.45`: ExecutableFacts becomes an authoritative direct fact.
- `fz-kdt.47`: demand derivation becomes independent of global evaluation order.
- `fz-tfn.1`: root product dependency state survives and receives exact movements across requests.
- Transitive settledness from `fz-kdt.44` remains the finality authority.

## TDD

1. Acyclic two-executable chain: exact formula evaluations and contributions.
2. Self recursion and two-member mutual recursion: monotone convergence without waits on peers.
3. Dynamic callable edge after initial values: add one dependency, preserve existing values, evaluate only affected readers.
4. Ground replacement and retraction: remove stale caller contributions and reach the new fixed point.
5. Several scheduler orders: identical semantic facts, causal work multiset, and backend program.
6. Same persistent root requested unchanged: zero demand evaluations.
7. Unreachable function redefinition: zero demand evaluations for the root.
8. Reached leaf redefinition: only the exact transitive demand-reader closure evaluates.
9. Target fixtures remain byte-correct across interp, run, and build.

## Telemetry acceptance

- Every non-initial formula evaluation names moved input content since its prior conclusion.
- Readiness-only movement causes zero demand calculation.
- Callable-edge growth causes zero reset or whole-cone replay.
- Equal conclusions do not revise facts or wake readers.
- No cone, round, SCC, root, or executable-inventory scan occurs.
- Work counts are used; no wall-clock threshold or evaluate-once claim is imposed on cyclic cells.

Before deleting cone telemetry, census `external_members` across the full matrix. Any observed external/displacement path must become a focused retraction/finality test; if none is observed, delete the path with its owner.

## Required deletions

- `collect_demand_cone`, `settle_demand_cone`, DemandConeRetryGuard, DemandGraph, SettledDemandCone, and actual_flow_edges.
- Demand-specific dirty sets and reverse indexes.
- PullSession return/input contribution, contributor, joined-demand, callee-inventory, and bespoke invalidation maps.
- Whole-cone publication and replay telemetry after the causal fact signal proves the replacement.
- Documentation that describes RuntimeDemand as an atomic product group.
- Temporary shadow facts, compatibility bridges, or comparison harnesses introduced during construction.

## Checks and documentation

Run focused fact/scheduler/product tests, full library, single-threaded fixture matrix, both large target fixtures on all three doors, cross-process determinism, and clippy with warnings denied. Rewrite fact-engine, pipeline, semantic-fixpoint, performance instrumentation, and `northstar.html` around the ordinary reactive formula and record every removed authority.
title: Replace RuntimeDemand cone replay with reactive per-executable facts
